item.title: Malwarebytes Launches 50% Off Black Friday Sale Across Subscriptions
item.description:
Malwarebytes Launches 50% Off Black Friday Sale Across Subscriptions

Malwarebytes has launched its 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale, dubbed “Block Friday,” offering 50% off security subscriptions for individuals, families, and small businesses. The promotion includes discounts on antivirus software, VPNs, identity theft protection, and personal data removal services.

⚙️ Individual Plans

Individual subscriptions provide protection for three devices with varying levels of security features:

  • Standard: Antivirus, anti-malware, scam protection, and ad blocking. Discounted from $59.99 to $29.99 per year.
  • Plus: All Standard features plus a no-log VPN. Discounted from $79.99 to $39.99 per year.
  • Essential: Device security, a VPN, and identity theft protection with $1 million in insurance coverage for one adult. Discounted from $129.99 to $64.99 per year.
  • Ultimate: Device security, a VPN, identity theft protection with $2 million in insurance coverage, three-bureau credit monitoring, and personal data removal for one adult. Discounted from $279.99 to $139.99 per year.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Plans

Family subscriptions protect up to 10 devices, with the following discounts:

  • Standard Family: Antivirus, anti-malware, scam protection, and ad blocking. Discounted from $119.99 to $59.99 per year.
  • Plus Family: All Standard Family features plus a no-log VPN. Discounted from $149.99 to $74.99 per year.
  • Essential Family: Device security, a VPN, and identity theft protection with $1 million in insurance coverage for two adults and 10 children. Discounted from $199.99 to $99.99 per year.
  • Ultimate Family: Device security, a VPN, identity theft protection, $2 million in insurance coverage, three-bureau credit monitoring, and personal data removal for two adults. Discounted from $399.99 to $199.99 per year.

💼 Small Business Plans

Subscriptions for small businesses cover 3, 10, or 20 devices and include antivirus protection against malware and ransomware, protection against malicious websites and scams, Wi-Fi privacy, and ad blocking. These plans support PCs, Macs, Android devices, and iPhones.

  • Sole Proprietor: Protects three devices. Discounted from $119.99 to $59.99 per year.
  • Boutique Business: Protects 10 devices. Discounted from $399.99 to $199.99 per year.
  • Small Office: Protects 20 devices. Discounted from $799.99 to $399.99 per year.

🚀 Availability

The promotion runs through December 6, 2026, at 11:59 PM PST. Existing Malwarebytes customers can log into their MyAccount dashboard to view personalized deals. Exact security features vary by operating system.

item.title: GitHub releases holiday gift guide featuring keyboard kit and merch
item.description:
GitHub releases holiday gift guide featuring keyboard kit and merch

GitHub has released a holiday gift guide for developers, featuring items from the GitHub Shop alongside a Black Friday discount. The guide is aimed at developers who may not have shared their wish lists, offering a selection of tech gear and merchandise.

⌨️ Hardware and Building

The GitHub x Omnitype Bauer Lite Keyboard Kit was featured at GitHub Universe in the Makerspace. Each GitHub-exclusive kit includes:

  • A hot-swap PCB with RGB underglow
  • Omnitype Hawk linear switches
  • Dye-sublimated PBT keycaps
  • Essential hardware and tools for a hands-on custom build

The kits arrive in randomly selected color combinations. For those interested in building, a step-by-step guide is available for beginners, and a new GitHub jigsaw puzzle is also offered for a different variety of building.

💡 Desk Accessories

To brighten up a desk, the guide suggests colorful desk mats, a selection of mugs and tumblers, and two specific items for coding decisions:

  • Copilot Amazeball: Sit on your desk; shake it to get an answer to burning questions, such as whether to ship on a Friday.
  • Mona Octobobble: A tiny teammate that nods along to ideas.

For comfort while agents work, the guide recommends a sleep mask and a cozy blanket for mid-afternoon naps.

👟 Travel and Apparel

Gifts for digital nomads include tech organizers, work totes, and skateboards. Apparel options include:

  • Invertocat hoodie: A classic popular item.
  • Mona Varsity jacket: For cold weather.
  • Cabana shirt and shorts co-ord: For warm weather.

🧸 Items for All Ages

The guide includes items for various age groups:

  • Invertocat onesie: For brand-new babies.
  • Mona bestie bottle and Mona plush: For tweens or younger fans.

🚚 Shipping and Deals

A special Black Friday deal offers free standard shipping through December 1, 2026. Shoppers can use the code FREESHIPBLOG26. To ensure gifts arrive by December 22, customers should check holiday shipping deadlines.

#GitHub #DeveloperTools #Hardware #HolidayGifts #BlackFriday
